stances_toward.note: A founding member that works inside the bloc and against its rules at once, the mirror image of the URY card's reading of Uruguay (reluctant_partner on MercoPress and bilaterals.org). At the Asuncion summit of 29-30 June 2026 Milei sought looser rules so that each member may negotiate trade deals alone, Argentina announced a CPTPP application, kept its veto on reinstating Venezuela (citing the Ushuaia Protocol) and met Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro the day the summit opened; Brazil answered with a Mercosur-Japan negotiation. Argentina still signs and ratifies the bloc's EU deal (26 Feb 2026), and the US deal is, in Argentina's reading, inside its 150 national exceptions to the common external tariff, while Brasilia counts about 200 items. Cooling: the CPTPP bid and the Brazil crisis. Bond none: interest only. Our grade reading follows the URY card's source; no source applies the word to Argentina (B for the facts, the word is ours).

relations_to.summary: Loosen the bloc so that each member may negotiate trade deals on its own. Milei put the demand at the Asuncion summit of 29-30 June 2026 and, in May, 'put Mercosur on notice' after the EU ratification; Argentina also keeps its veto on reinstating Venezuela (Ushuaia Protocol). Brazil opposes the direction and proposed reopening the Venezuela question.

relations_to.summary: Brazil examined the US-Argentina trade agreement for breaches of Mercosur rules (tariffs, rules of origin, technical barriers). Argentina says the cuts fall inside its 150 national exceptions to the common external tariff; Brazilian officials told Reuters the deal covers close to 200 items. The US removed tariffs on 1,675 Argentine lines and raised the beef quota; Argentina gave preferential access to about 200 US lines. Foreign Minister Quirno argued the bloc does not bar such agreements and that parts could be applied by decree while the full pact needs Congress. Brazil raised the issue formally at a March preparatory meeting; any answer was expected at the council level in June (outcome not found).
